title: Lena and the Winter
author: Lior Joubert
blurb: Silas Delacroix, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
